content:
The image shows a mango leaf with discrete, irregular dark brown/black necrotic lesions scattered across the upper surface. The lesions have defined edges and appear sunken or dried out. No white powdery coating, no sooty black surface film, no tip/shoot dieback pattern.

These are classic anthracnose lesions: angular to irregular dark spots on the leaf lamina, characteristic of *Colletotrichum gloeosporioides* infection on mango.
